LESSON: ASANAS (PHYSICAL POSTURES)

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: General
Strand: Yoga (Holistic wellness)
Topic 6.1: Asanas (Physical postures)

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Asanas (Physical postures). Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Asanas (Physical postures)
2. Practise Asanas (Physical postures) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Asanas (Physical postures)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Asanas (Physical postures)
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Asanas (Physical postures). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Asanas (Physical postures) at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Asanas (Physical postures) at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Asanas (Physical postures)
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Asanas (Physical postures). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Asanas (Physical postures) using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Asanas (Physical postures) in the examples.
2. Explain Asanas (Physical postures) to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Asanas (Physical postures).
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Asanas (Physical postures) using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Asanas (Physical postures) important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Asanas (Physical postures)
2. Practise Asanas (Physical postures) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Asanas (Physical postures)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
